title: 第九章 噩梦梦境恐惧印记第十章 梦魔的诞生虚幻吞噬
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
无边的绚烂光雾之中，陆羽缓步前行，同时也在警惕的打量着四周，小心周围可能出现的危险。
以及，看看能不能碰到，那些弱小的梦魔。
很快，陆羽的身影，便是被淹没在了光雾海洋之中，周围尽是无尽绚烂光雾。
若非是他与梦境世界之间，有着一股难以分割的联系，他都要迷失其中了。
半晌过去，陆羽周围，依旧还是那一片绚烂的光雾，没有任何的异样之处。
就在陆羽有些不耐烦，准备返回去的时候，却是猛然间在他前方，发现了一道黑色的影子，在那绚烂的光雾之中一闪之间，又被淹没在绚烂的光雾海洋。
“诶~！”
陆羽眼前一亮，立即便是快速的向前行去。
在来到附近的时候，陆羽又是放慢脚步，慢慢的靠近过去。
一颗黑色的球体，在一片绚烂光雾之中若隐若现。
“嗯~？”
看着那颗黑色球体，陆羽有些茫然，这是个什么玩意儿？似乎不是梦魔啊。
在略微沉吟过后，陆羽还是决定上前看看情况。
一步一步，陆羽来到那颗黑色球体七八米远的时候，便就暂停了脚步。
这个距离，正是他在这方光雾空间之中，所能攻击到的最远距离了。
念头转动之间，恐惧之力瞬间扩散，向着前方快速的延伸而去。
顷刻间，陆羽前方那片绚烂的光雾，都似乎猛然暗淡了一些，气息变得压抑起来。
很快，那光雾暗淡的情况，便已经蔓延至了那颗黑色球体所在。
“嗡嗡嗡...”
在被恐惧之力触碰到的一瞬间，那颗黑色的球体便是剧烈震颤起来，将其周围的光雾，都是荡起了一圈圈的涟漪。

一股股的恐惧力量，不断融入他的恐惧之力当中，涌入他的梦境世界，使其吞噬光雾的速度，都是加快了许多。
而陆羽也是感觉自己的精神，更加的饱满有力起来。
不过此时的陆羽，可是没有时间理会这些。
“这是...”
陆羽目瞪口呆的看着前方那颗黑色球体，看那抖动的架势，似乎要崩溃了一般。
“呃...崩溃?！
...
卧槽！
...”
陆羽瞬间反应过来，连忙便是收回了外放的恐惧之力。
不过，虽然陆羽已经将恐惧之力散去，但是那颗黑色球体的震动，也仅仅只是稍微放缓了一些，依旧是在不断的崩溃之中的。
不由的，陆羽便是快走几步，来到了那颗黑色球体面前。
放眼看去，其中有着一幅幅光怪陆离的画面闪过，似乎是一处昏暗的废弃老楼，有着一个模糊的黑影鬼怪出没，正在不断的追逐着其中一个女孩身影。
而涌入陆羽梦境世界的恐惧之力，似乎大部分便是从那个女孩身上产生的。
content_en:
In the boundless brilliant light mist, Lu Yu moved forward slowly, while also looking around vigilantly, careful of possible dangers around him.
And, see if you can encounter those weak dream demons.
Soon, Lu Yu's figure was submerged in the ocean of light and mist, surrounded by endless gorgeous light and mist.
If it weren't for the inseparable connection between him and the dream world, he would have been lost in it.
After a while, Lu Yu's surroundings were still filled with brilliant haze of light, nothing out of the ordinary.
Just when Lu Yu was a little impatient and was about to go back, he suddenly spotted a black shadow in front of him. In the blink of an eye, he was submerged in the gorgeous light mist.
"Eh~!"
Lu Yu's eyes lit up and he immediately moved forward quickly.
When he arrived nearby, Lu Yu slowed down again and approached slowly.
A black sphere was looming in the brilliant haze of light.
"Hmm~?"
Looking at the black sphere, Lu Yu was a little confused. What is this? It doesn't seem like a dream demon.
After pondering for a while, Lu Yu decided to step forward to take a look at the situation.
Step by step, Lu Yu stopped when he came seven or eight meters away from the black sphere.
This distance is the farthest he can attack in this light mist space.
As the thoughts turned, the power of fear spread instantly and quickly extended towards the front.
In an instant, the gorgeous haze of light in front of Lu Yu seemed to dim suddenly, and his aura became suppressed.
Soon, the dim light mist spread to the black sphere.
"Buzz buzz..."
The moment it was touched by the power of fear, the black sphere trembled violently, causing ripples in the light mist around it.
Wave after wave of fear power continued to merge into his fear power, pouring into his dream world, making it swallow the light and mist much faster.
And Lu Yu also felt that his spirit became fuller and more powerful.
But at this time, Lu Yu had no time to care about this.
"This is..."
Lu Yu stared at the black sphere in front of him in stunned silence. Judging from the trembling posture, it seemed as if it was about to collapse.
“Uh...collapse?!
...
Damn it!
..."
Lu Yu reacted instantly and quickly withdrew the power of fear he had unleashed.
However, although Lu Yu had dissipated the power of fear, the vibration of the black sphere had only slowed down slightly, and it was still collapsing.
Involuntarily, Lu Yu took a few steps and came to the black sphere.
Looking around, there are strange pictures flashing through it. It seems to be a dark abandoned old building, with a vague black shadow ghost haunting it, and it is constantly chasing one of the girls.
Most of the fear that poured into Lu Yu's dream world seemed to come from that girl.
